name: Trace each placed position to its sources in Evidence mode (signed in, v2)
description: Validates Evidence mode: the placed positions with their placement card, and the sources sheet listing every source with a link that opens in a new tab, with a working filter and an empty state.

planSteps.description: Type testsprite+clerk_test@example.com in the "Email address" field and click Continue
Wait until the code screen ("Check your email") shows "Didn't receive a code?", then type 424242; Clerk usually continues by itself after the 6th digit, so click Continue only if it is still shown

If Clerk answers "You need to send a verification code before attempting to verify", click Resend once it is enabled and type 424242 again; then wait up to 30 seconds until the URL is no longer under /sign-in
Navigate to /cases/eagle-s-2024 and wait up to 60 seconds for the 3D view (data-testid seabed-view) to reach data-state "ready"
Click "Evidence" in the mode switch (data-testid mode-switch)
Assert the card "How the track is placed" (data-testid placement-card) lists exactly 3 positions at 10:26, 16:44 and 22:28, the first one "Over Estlink 2, about 55 km south of Loviisa"
Assert a card (data-testid placement-popover) opens titled "Over Estlink 2, about 55 km south of Loviisa" that says the position is "placed from statements"
Press Escape to close the card, then click "All sources" (data-testid open-sources)

Assert a sheet titled "Sources" (data-testid source-list) opens with the line "18 pages. Every quote in this case is copied from them.", lists 18 numbered sources, and shows 18 "Open the page" links that each open in a new tab (target _blank)
Type "Cinia" in the sheet's search box "Filter by title or publisher"
Assert every source still listed contains "Cinia" and "Fault detected in Cinia C-Lion1 submarine cable" is among them
Replace the search text with "no such publisher"
Assert the sheet shows "No source title or publisher contains no such publisher."
Assert the sources sheet is closed
